title: Upgraded Upper/Posterior Split
author: Louis Lestner
desc:
For those who want to specialise in the ‘movie star’ muscles to get that superhero look, whilst getting strong in the process. 

Your main performance metrics are flat smith bench, 30° incline smith bench, bent over barbell rows and zercher squats.
